description: KittenML is the model brand of Stellon Labs, Inc., a Delaware corporation whose terms place disputes in San Francisco courts. It publishes the Kitten-TTS models on Hugging Face (lightweight 15M-80M-parameter v0.8 models and Kitten-TTS 2, a 1-bit model with voice cloning and emotion tags) and also sells a hosted, OpenAI-compatible TTS and speech-to-text API, with free use of the weights for commercial users under $1M revenue.
name: KittenML
